clauses.quote: Unit member's applications will be submitted within ten (10) duty days of the date of the posting of the summer school positions
tentative selection and notification of candidates shall occur within fifteen (15) duty days of the close of applications, but no later than five (5) calendar days before the end of the school year.
clauses.subject_text: tentative selection and notification of candidates

clauses.quote: Priority consideration for summer school assignments shall be given to unit members fully credentialed/certified for the summer school assignment.
clauses.subject_text: Priority consideration for summer school assignments

clauses.quote: Where two or more qualified unit members apply for the same position, seniority in the District shall govern.
The District shall not be arbitrary, capricious, or unreasonable with respect to summer school intersession assignments.
For elementary traditional summer school, priority shall be given to unit members regularly assigned to the summer school site.

Elementary unit members regularly assigned to sites that do not offer summer school/intersession shall be placed in the eligibility pool at the school where summer school students from their home site are assigned.
clauses.subject_text: Elementary unit members regularly assigned to sites that do not offer summer school/intersession
